changelog: **Mentor-gated, quota'd company → candidate message channel (#1840):** new tenant model `CandidateOutreach` (`@@unique([companyId, menteeId])`, `@@index([orgId, status])`, in `TENANT_MODELS`). `POST /api/company/outreach` (COMPANY) refuses unless the candidate is shortlisted by the company (an `Application` at `SHORTLISTED`+ or a `SHORTLISTED` `CompanyInterest`, else 404), has an active `TALENT_POOL_VISIBILITY` consent, has no pending/open/90-day-revoked request, and the company is under its monthly quota (`403 { code: 'quota_exceeded', limit, used }`; `Company.quota` overrides the new `outreachMonthlyQuota` setting, default 20; counted at request time). The first message is stored, not delivered. `PATCH /api/company/outreach/[id]`: the active mentor or an admin approves/declines with a guarded `updateMany` — approval opens/reuses the DIRECT conversation, posts the message and names the company to the candidate; a decline reveals nothing; the candidate revokes, which removes the company user from the thread and `canMessage()` (now also true for an approved outreach) refuses further posts. Visibility is one rule, `outreachActorWhere()`. Pure rules in `src/lib/outreachRule.ts` (unit-tested); in-app `outreach.*` notifications only; `docs/candidate-outreach.md`. UI: request card on the company's candidate page, a role-aware panel on `/messages`.

en: A company that shortlisted a candidate can now ask to send them a message — the candidate's programme team reviews it first, and the candidate can close the conversation at any time.
tr: Bir adayı kısa listeye alan firma artık ona mesaj göndermek için talepte bulunabilir — önce adayın program ekibi inceler ve aday sohbeti istediği an kapatabilir.
de: Ein Unternehmen, das eine Person in die engere Wahl genommen hat, kann jetzt anfragen, ihr eine Nachricht zu senden — zuerst prüft das Programmteam, und die Person kann das Gespräch jederzeit schließen.
